introduction: Minnesota unemployment insurance provides temporary partial wage replacement for eligible workers who lose work or have substantially reduced hours.
description: Minnesota unemployment insurance provides temporary partial wage replacement for eligible workers who lose work or have substantially reduced hours.

sections.who: DEED reviews work history and eligibility. Weekly requirements continue after the initial claim.
sections.get: The benefit-account determination shows the calculated amount; a separate eligibility decision may also be needed.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Use the current site

    Go to ui.mn.gov. It replaced uimn.org; existing login details still work.

  2. Apply for benefits

    Complete the application and review all notices in the account.

  3. Request weekly payments

    Follow the payment-request instructions and accurately report work and earnings.
sections.after: Read eligibility decisions and requests promptly. An account calculation alone does not establish payable eligibility.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Current UI website notice; Application process; Applicant information. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
